messages:
maria (oncall): Morning handoff — quick notes for night team.

- What changed: rolled canary quantized-gpt v2.1 at 09:12 UTC (10% traffic). Observed 95p latency bump (~120ms -> 420ms) on long contexts; scaled back to 2% at 09:30; canary now at 5%.
- What to watch: embedding queue depth (/metrics/embedding_queue_depth), and 95th token latency for quantized variants (/dash/latency/quantized-gpt).
- Known risk: KV-cache evictions increased after the canary due to sequence-length anomalies; keeping cache_timeout at 30s for now.
- Maintenance: Postgres index rebuild 02:00–02:40 UTC tomorrow; expect short spikes for DB reads.
- Action items: (1) watch embedding queue and scale workers if >1000 for 5m, (2) hold canary at 5% unless stable for 2h, (3) ping infra if DB spikes >5s.

Tom: Taking overnight. I'll add a short alert to be notified if embedding_queue_depth > 500 for 3m. Also will keep the canary pinned at 5% until 11:30 UTC. :thumbsup:

Jen: Quick FYI — two PRs still blocking rollout: #4823 (model quant args) and #4841 (batching fix). @tom can you skim #4823? small param rename, should be quick.

Tom: Yep, I'll review #4823 now. If anything critical I'll ping in this thread.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy event: quantized-gpt v2.1 -> 10% at 09:12 UTC; scaled to 5% at 09:30 UTC. Metrics: error-rate +0.2%, 95th-lat +300ms. (link: https://deploys.redwood/quantized-gpt/1865)

ops-bot: Alert sanity-check: embedding_queue_depth alert currently fires at 300/1m. Suggested temporary rule: fire at 500/3m for night coverage to reduce noise. Will propose a PD if approved.

maria (oncall): Approved to change to 500/3m for the night. If it hits, scale workers by +2 replicas and notify infra. Leaving runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-queue

Tom: Done — updated alert to 500/3m and added a runbook step in the alert message. Will monitor next 2h. :eyes:

Jen: Thanks — I'll unblock #4823 this afternoon if Tom has no blockers. Leaving calendar note about DB maintenance. Good handoff, team. :rocket:
